name: Fray Island
summary: Fray Island is a windswept, rocky islet lying just off the Merchant Coast of the Barrens. Home to a rough-and-tumble training ring, it is famous as a neutral haven where warriors from across Azeroth come to test their mettle.

sections.title: A Proving Ground for Brawlers
sections.body: Situated off the eastern bluffs of the Barrens, Fray Island is far removed from the watchful eyes of both Orgrimmar and Theramore. The island serves as a training place for warriors of all races and creeds. At its heart sits a fighting arena overseen by Klannoc Macleod, where seasoned fighters and raw recruits gather to compete in brutal brawls.

sections.title: The Trial of the Affray
sections.body: Despite the hostility of the surrounding waters, the island's central ring adheres to a simple code of martial combat. Warriors journey here on the instructions of their trainers to take part in 'The Affray'—a grueling gauntlet against waves of challengers culminating in a bout against the champion Big Will. Here, allegiance to Horde or Alliance is set aside in favor of raw strength and martial discipline.

faq.q: What is Fray Island used for?
faq.answer: The island serves as a training ground for warriors and the site of a brutal combat trial known as The Affray. Warriors of both factions travel here to prove their endurance and master advanced stances.
No kingdom or faction rules it. The island is a training place for warriors of all races and creeds, and its combat ring operates under the watchful eye of warrior trainer Klannoc Macleod.

faq.q: How do I reach Fray Island?
aliases: how to get to fray island
faq.answer: Fray Island lies in the Great Sea off the eastern coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet. Reaching it requires a long swim from the mainland shores through shark- and frenzy-infested waters.
The Affray is a trial of endurance held in the island's fighting cage. A warrior must stand atop the grate and defeat successive waves of challengers before finally besting the brawler Big Will.

angles.text: Fray Island is a crucial proving ground for your training. Klannoc Macleod and the trial of the Affray will test whether you have the discipline and power to adopt the Berserker Stance.
Klannoc Macleod is a human, yet the warriors who gather in his ring share a bond of combat that crosses racial lines.
